question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3. **
solution: The correct answer is: **Snapping** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Snapping **means breaking suddenly with a sharp noise. (तेज आवाज के साथ अचानक टूटना) • **For example**: *The twig snapped under the weight of the bird.* • The word "**snapping**" in this sentence is used to describe the motion of his wings as they interact with the rushing wind. • It suggests a quick, sharp, and controlled movement, similar to the way sails on a ship might catch the wind to propel the vessel forward. • Grammatically, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Losing **means misplacing or no longer having something. (किसी चीज़ का खो जाना या उसके पास अब न होना) • **Cleaning **means removing dirt or unwanted substances from a surface or object. (किसी सतह या वस्तु से गंदगी या अवांछित पदार्थ हटाना) • **Limiting **means setting a boundary or restriction on something. (किसी चीज़ पर सीमा या प्रतिबंध लगाना) 45:Tbaf, The correct answer is: **Effort**
